abstract: Student feedback is a critical input for continuous improvement in higher education, yet traditional end-of-semester written surveys suffer from low response rates, superficial answers, satisficing, and limited actionability. Voice-based conversational AI agents can conduct structured interviews at scale, asking open-ended questions and probing follow-ups, and may capture richer qualitative feedback than written instruments. This research proposal asks what characteristics, depth, and strategic value feedback collected through voice-based conversational AI agents has in higher education, and whether such agents elicit detailed, honest, and actionable feedback that can support instructional improvement and institutional learning. Drawing on survey-mode-effects research, the Computers As Social Actors (CASA) paradigm, and dynamic capabilities theory, we develop three hypotheses on elaboration, social presence and disclosure, and actionability. A completed technical pilot at the Technical University of Munich established the feasibility of telephone-based AI interviews; the main field study is planned for the "Advanced Leadership Communication" course at MIT Sloan with approximately 60 students, using a convergent mixed-methods design and a four-dimensional coding framework for actionability (specificity, thematic richness, constructive orientation, contextual depth). The study extends CASA theory to evaluative educational settings, characterizes voice-based AI as a distinct feedback modality, and links micro-level feedback quality to institutional sensing capabilities.

ob.ai_reason: 语音AI用于高等教育反馈，AI核心，边缘教育管理
ob.tldr: 针对高等教育中传统期末问卷反馈率低、内容浅、可用性差的问题，研究者提出用语音对话式AI代理开展结构化访谈的研究计划。基于调查模式效应、CASA范式及动态能力理论提出三项假设（详尽度、社会临场与披露、行动性），已在慕尼黑工业大学完成电话AI访谈技术可行性试点，将在MIT Sloan约60人的高级领导沟通课程开展主研究，采用混合方法与四维行动性编码框架。

ur.ai_reason: 语音AI教育反馈，研究提案含用户视角
ur.tldr: 研究计划探讨语音对话式AI在高等教育学生反馈场景中能否获取比传统书面问卷更丰富、诚实、可操作的反馈。技术可行性已在慕尼黑工业大学验证，主研究将在MIT Sloan约60名学生中开展，结合CASA范式与调查模式效应理论，采用混合方法与四维可操作性编码框架（具体性、主题丰富度、建设性、情境深度），将CASA理论拓展至教育评价场景，刻画语音AI为独立反馈媒介。

title: Voice-Based AI Feedback in Higher Education: A Field Study on Quality and Actionability
